scope: Development-only exploratory precision-recall decision analysis. The original final test was completed under its historical freeze on 2026-10-22, then examined diagnostically. No new independent test is available. The previously seen development audit is an exploratory fixed-rule recheck.
selection_rule: All distinct tune Scratch scores; positive iff score>=threshold; nonempty precision feasibility 5*TP>=4*(TP+FP). Maximize TP, then exact precision, then threshold. No feasible threshold means null/no rule selected.
nine_class_rule: If p(Scratch)>=frozen threshold choose Scratch; otherwise argmax of the other eight columns. Ties follow fixed class order.
